A '''corrupted beacon''' is an {{MCD|artifact}} that can be found in various {{MCD|mission}}s. Its unique variant is the {{MCD|corrupted pumpkin}}, making it the only artifact to have a unique variant. It functions similarly to the {{MCD|eye of the guardian}} from the {{MCD|Hidden Depths}} {{MCD|DLC}}.

== Lore ==
While it isn't "clear how this beacon got corrupted", it may have "something to do with the {{MCD|Arch-Illager}} and the {{MCD|Orb of Dominance}}". In ''[[Minecraft Legends]]'', the corrupted beacon makes an appearance in the {{MCL|Night Beacon}} base.<ref>{{mcnet|-corrupted-beacon|Taking Inventory: Corrupted Beacon|February 20, 2026|[[Duncan Geere]]|archive-url|archive-time|url-prefix}}</ref>

== Usage ==
The corrupted beacon fires a beam, called a shadow beam that can pierce mobs, dealing 10% of the base value as damage and consumes 2 souls every 0.1 seconds. With the base maximum soul capacity of 300, the beacon can be fired for up to 15 seconds. The beam is toggleable, meaning it can be sustained without the need to continuously hold down its slot button. However, it will enter cooldown after the beam is cancelled.

The beam fired has a massive range (about 40 blocks away) that exceeds the boundaries of the screen, and cannot pass through walls.

=== Properties ===  
* X artifact damage per second
* 2.5 Seconds cooldown
* +1 Soul Gathering
* Requires [[MCD:Souls|souls]]

== Quotes ==
{{Quote|'''CORRUPTED BEACON''' – The Corrupted Beacon fires an intense magical beam that damages mobs unlikely enough to be in the way. It is capable of causing massive amounts of damage.|''Guide to Minecraft Dungeons:<br>A Handbook for Heroes''}}

{{Quote|What’s better than firing a deadly laser beam at a bunch of hostile {{MCD|mob}}s? Firing a bright purple deadly laser beam, of course! This light is so pretty that I’m often tempted to shine it into my own eyes, but I know that’s a stupid idea, which is why I’ve only done it sixteen times since starting this sentence. And fifty-eight times during this one, even though this sentence is shorter. Weird huh? 

'''PROS''': Covers a large area. Aforementioned prettiness.

'''CONS''': Name sounds distractingly like "bacon" and I’m writing this before lunchtime.|[[Tom Stone]]<ref>{{mcnet|minecraft-dungeons--9-essential-artifacts|Minecraft Dungeons: 9 essential artifacts|August 24, 2020|[[Tom Stone]]|archive-url=|archive-time=|prefix=|quote=Terrific talismans to help you triumph!}}</ref>|image=Mojavatar Tom-Stone.png}}

== Trivia == 
* In ''[[Minecraft Dungeons Arcade]]'', the corrupted beacon is classified as a ranged weapon despite being an artifact.
